purpose: Hand-labelled free-text outcome reports for the extraction step (outcome_report.py). Each case lists only the fields that should be extracted; every other field must stay empty. The target for the extraction step is >=90% field-level extraction accuracy. Synthetic reports written for this test, not real PM reports, so it measures whether the extraction behaves on the cases anticipated, which is weaker than real reports; replace or extend it with real ones as they arrive.
tolerances: accuracy +-0.5 points; latency, volume and cost within 1%; model matched by name; verdict matched exactly. latency_statistic and latency_kind are checked only where a case states them.
